rec.name: Product Teaser Text (Metafield-Driven Subtitle on Collection Cards & PDP)
rec.status: Built — live; display bug reported Mar 2025 and explained in a Loom (cause not documented in ticket)

what.text: A short, editable one-line teaser text is shown directly under the product title. It appears in the collection grid cards (between title and price) and in the PDP header (between title and price). It is maintained per product in a Rich Text metafield called 'Teaser-Texte' (Teaser texts). Examples seen: 'Das perfekte Produkt für den Start' (The perfect product to get started), 'Nachfüllpack für 6 Riegeltage' (Refill pack for 6 bar days), 'Leckere Ergänzung zu deinen Riegeltagen' (Tasty add-on to your bar days).

why.text: A one-line benefit or use-case message right at the point of decision tells shoppers who the product is for or how it fits their plan (starter, refill, add-on). This reduces the effort of picking between similar bundles and supports cross-sell. It carries the value message into the grid, so shoppers don't need to open the PDP to understand the product. Repeating the same line on the PDP keeps the message consistent. Missing teasers on some cards create visual gaps and uneven cards, which weakens that consistency.

how.text: 1) Create a product metafield 'Teaser-Texte' (type: Rich Text) and fill it in the product admin page. 2) In the theme (Sectionfy section on the collection template and the PDP product-info block), output the metafield below the product title and above the price, only when it is not blank. 3) Render the rich text as inline/short text styled small and regular-weight. 4) QA every product in the collection: if a metafield is filled but nothing appears, check that the section/block reads the correct metafield namespace/key and that the render does not depend on a different condition. The ticket's Loom explains the cause of the original bug, but the details are not captured in the text.

items: Teaser text content per product (Rich Text metafield 'Teaser-Texte')
Display on collection cards (below title, above price)
Display on PDP (below title, above price)
Fallback behaviour when the metafield is empty (currently nothing is rendered, leaving a gap)

dependencies.text: Product metafield 'Teaser-Texte' (Rich Text) must exist and be exposed to the storefront. Requires the Sectionfy collection section and a PDP title/info area that can output the metafield. The theme is a custom Shopify theme (store inngreen-diaet). Editors must fill the metafield for each product, otherwise the card has no teaser.

items: Conversion rate and AOV for the products shown with a teaser
Share of products with a filled teaser (content QA)
